title: HA-VLN 2.0: An Open Benchmark and Leaderboard for Human-Aware Navigation in Discrete and Continuous Environments with Dynamic Multi-Human Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2503.14229v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has been studied mainly in either discrete or continuous spaces, with little attention to dynamic, crowded environments. We present HA-VLN 2.0, a unified benchmark introducing explicit social-awareness constraints. Our contributions are: (i) a standardized task and metrics capturing both goal accuracy and personal-space adherence; (ii) HAPS 2.0 dataset and simulators modeling multi-human interactions, outdoor contexts, and finer language-motion alignment; (iii) benchmarks on 16,844 socially grounded instructions, revealing sharp performance drops of leading agents under human dynamics and partial observability; and (iv) real-world robot experiments validating sim-to-real transfer, with an open leaderboard enabling transparent comparison. Results show that explicit social modeling improves navigation robustness and reduces collisions, underscoring necessity of human-centric approaches. By releasing

translated_title: HA-VLN 2.0：面向离散与连续环境中动态多人交互的人类感知导航开放基准与排行榜
translated_abstract: 视觉与语言导航（VLN）主要在离散或连续空间中进行研究，很少关注动态、拥挤的环境。我们提出了HA-VLN 2.0，一个引入显式社会感知约束的统一基准。我们的贡献包括：（i）一个标准化的任务和度量标准，同时捕捉目标准确性和个人空间遵守情况；（ii）HAPS 2.0数据集和模拟器，模拟多人交互、户外场景以及更精细的语言-运动对齐；（iii）对16,844条社会性指令的基准测试，揭示了领先智能体在人类动态和部分可观测性下的性能显著下降；（iv）真实世界机器人实验验证了仿真到现实的迁移，并提供了一个开放排行榜以实现透明比较。结果表明，显式社会建模提高了导航鲁棒性并减少了碰撞，强调了以人为中心方法的必要性。通过发布...
tldr: 该论文提出了HA-VLN 2.0基准，通过引入社会感知约束、动态多人交互数据集和开放排行榜，显著提升了视觉语言导航在拥挤环境中的鲁棒性并减少了碰撞。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HA-VLN 2.0 benchmark, which enhances vision-language navigation robustness in crowded environments and reduces collisions by incorporating explicit social-awareness constraints, dynamic multi-human interaction datasets, and an open leaderboard.
